description: Fork of exp213 (V LUT, val_bpb=1.7670 @ 8K, 114M). Single change: V2D n_pairs from E*log2(E)=1456 to 2*E*log2(E)=2912. V2D is used only for Q, K (V uses LUT). Wq, Wk grow to [H, 2912, 64] (+6.7M params total). Hypothesis: with V removed from V2D, increasing V2D pair count for Q/K alone might help attention discrimination without the negative effect seen in exp210 (where V also used the larger V2D).
